title: Experienced Technical Research Writer/Research Analyst
description:
**Senior Technical Research Engineer/Technical Research Engineer**

**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹1,00,000 per month (Based on experience, expertise, publications, and output)

**Location:** Gandhipuram, Coimbatore  
**Work Mode:** Full-Time | In-Office Only (No Remote)

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Senior Technical Research Engineer/ Technical Research Engineer with strong academic writing and research experience to independently handle AI/ML and Computer Science research projects.

The ideal candidate should be capable of managing research papers, thesis documentation, technical reports, publication activities, and mentoring junior researchers.

This position requires independent ownership of research writing assignments and the ability to convert technical concepts into publication-ready content.

**Areas You May Work On**

* Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
* Data Science & Analytics
* Computer Vision & Image Processing
* Cybersecurity
* Computer Networks
* General Computer Science Research

**Key Responsibilities**

* Independently write and review research papers
* Prepare and structure thesis chapters
* Conduct systematic literature reviews
* Analyze research gaps and formulate contributions
* Convert technical implementations into publication-ready manuscripts
* Prepare review papers and survey articles
* Mentor junior research engineers
* Ensure quality, clarity, and academic compliance
* Support journal submission and revision processes

**Eligibility**

**Education: Only Engineering Graduates**

* M.E / M.Tech
* B.E./B.Tech

**Experience**

* Minimum 2 years of research writing experience
* Demonstrated experience in journal paper or thesis preparation

**Required Skills**

* Strong academic writing ability
* Experience with research paper preparation
* Experience with thesis writing and documentation
* Strong literature review and reference management skills
* Understanding of publication standards
* Ability to independently handle research assignments
* Strong technical English communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

Candidates with any of the following will receive preference:

* Published papers in Scopus or SCI journals
* Experience handling thesis documentation
* Experience mentoring junior researchers
* Exposure to AI/ML, Computer Vision, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related Computer Science domains

**Career Growth**

***Senior Technical Research Engineer***  
***↓***  
***Research Team Lead***  
***↓***  
***Research Project Manager***

**Selection Process**

* Advanced Technical Writing Assessment
* Face-to-Face Technical Interview
* Research Discussion Round

**Important Requirements**

* Full-time in-office role in Coimbatore
* Must be willing to work more than 1 year
* Must be comfortable handling multiple research assignments
* Strong communication and deadline management skills
* Candidates should be genuinely interested in long-term collaboration
* Prior publication experience is preferred but practical research-writing ability will be the primary evaluation criterion

**Growth & Work Environment**

* Opportunity to work on **real research publications**
* Exposure to **diverse AI/ML and CS problem domains**
* Mentorship and collaboration with experienced researchers
* Opportunity to **mentor junior research trainees**

**How to Apply:**

Apply here or **Email Resume with suitable subject:**  
softscholarshrd@gmail.com

**Walk-In Interview:**  
Thursdays | Strictly 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM  
Gandhipuram, Coimbatore

**Location:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/BStgnS9pvjUdys6A8

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* We need long-term commitment. Will you work more than 1 year in this company?

* Master's (Required)

* Journal Paper/Thesis Writing: 2 years (Required)

title: Research Associate Trainee – Computer Science Academic Writer
description:
**Research Associate Trainee – Computer Science Academic Writer**

**Location:** Gandhipuram, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Work Mode:** Full-Time | In-Office Only

**Salary**

**Training Period:** ₹10,000 per month

**After Confirmation:** ₹15,000 per month

**About the Role**

We are looking for enthusiastic **Research Associate Trainees** who are interested in building a career in academic research, technical writing, and Computer Science research.

This is a structured training role where you will learn how research papers, literature reviews, technical reports, and thesis documents are prepared for international journals and conferences.

You will work under the guidance of experienced researchers and gradually take ownership of research support activities as your skills develop.

**Research Domains**

You will gain exposure to projects in one or more of the following areas:

* Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
* Data Science & Analytics
* Computer Vision & Image Processing
* Cybersecurity
* Computer Networks
* Internet of Things (IoT)
* General Computer Science Research

**Training & Responsibilities**

During your training period, you will learn to:

* Search and analyze recent research papers
* Conduct literature reviews and summarize research findings
* Organize references and citations using IEEE and other academic formats
* Format research papers, theses, and technical documents
* Prepare comparison tables and research summaries
* Assist in manuscript preparation and documentation
* Support senior researchers with publication-related activities
* Improve technical writing and academic English
* Learn the research publication process from idea to submission

Responsibilities will gradually increase based on your learning progress and performance.

**A Typical Day in This Role**

You may spend your day:

* Reading and summarizing research papers
* Preparing literature review tables
* Formatting research manuscripts
* Organizing references and citations
* Assisting with technical documentation
* Supporting senior researchers in ongoing projects

**Education**

* Only Engineering Graduates: B.E. / B.Tech (Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics & Communication, or related disciplines)

**Experience**

* Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with up to 1 year of experience in research writing, technical writing, thesis documentation, or academic projects may also apply.

**Preferred Skills**

* Good written and reading skills in English
* Basic understanding of Computer Science concepts
* Strong analytical and logical thinking
* Attention to detail
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Word
* Interest in research and technical documentation
* Willingness to learn new concepts and work in a research-oriented environment

**Why Join Us?**

* Hands-on training in academic research and technical writing
* Exposure to real-world AI and Computer Science research projects
* Structured mentorship from experienced researchers
* Opportunity to contribute to research publications
* Collaborative and learning-focused work environment
* Long-term career growth opportunities

**Career Path**

Research Associate Trainee

↓

Research Associate

↓

Technical Research Engineer

↓

Senior Technical Research Engineer

↓

Research Team Lead

**Selection Process**

**Round 1:** Technical & English Writing Assessment

**Round 2:** Face-to-Face Interview (Mandatory)

**Important Hiring Policy**

* This is a full-time, in-office position based in Gandhipuram, Coimbatore.
* Candidates should be comfortable commuting or relocating before joining.
* Timely communication throughout the recruitment process is expected.
* Candidates who miss interviews without prior notice or repeatedly fail to respond to communication may not be considered for future openings.

title: TECHNICAL WRITER
description:
**Department:** Factory Operations

**Location:** Homworks Plant – Sulur, Coimbatore

**Role Type:** Full-Time | On-Site (Shop-Floor Support)

**BE PART OF SOMETHING BIG.**

Join **Homworks** at Sulur, Coimbatore, as we build and scale a landmark **35-acre manufacturing facility** powered by state-of-the-art, fully automated German machinery lines.

We are looking for a detailed-oriented **Technical Writer** to work directly alongside our **Factory Head** and operational teams. In this role, you will get firsthand exposure to industrial operations, working close to the shop floor to translate complex manufacturing processes into clear, accurate, and structured documentation.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Shop-Floor Observation & Process Capture:** Observe manufacturing activities, machine workflows, operational discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives directly on the shop floor.
* **Documentation & Standard Operating Procedures:** Draft, format, and maintain clear English SOPs, process flow notes, work instructions, quality checklists, technical reports, and operating manuals.
* **Active Learning & Synthesis:** Engage with engineers and technicians, ask probing questions, and convert complex technical jargon or machinery processes into simple, easy-to-understand documents.
* **Action & Information Tracking:** Track key decisions, observations, and action points from operational meetings; keep all documents meticulously organized, updated, and accessible.
* **Factory Head Coordination:** Provide direct administrative, documentation, and coordination support to the Factory Head to support smooth daily operations and execution.

**WHO SHOULD APPLY (QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS)**

* **Strong English Communication:** Flawless written English, excellent grammar, and the ability to explain complex technical concepts in a logical, concise manner.
* **Sharp Analytical & Listening Skills:** Strong observational capabilities, active listening skills, high attention to detail, and a genuine curiosity about industrial machinery and manufacturing operations.
* **Shop-Floor Mindset:** Willingness to spend time on the active production floor, collaborate directly with factory operators, and grow alongside the facility.
* **Experience Level:** Candidates with prior manufacturing/industrial exposure are preferred; ambitious freshers with exceptional technical writing ability and a passion for plant operations are welcome to apply.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

description:

**Company:** Antsquad Branding Studio  
**Location:** Coimbatore (Near Anna Salai)

**About Highthink Media Solutions**

We are an innovative branding agency, committed to delivering exceptional brand experiences through strategic design and creative solutions. Our agency works with diverse clients across various industries, offering branding, strategy, and digital services. We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Project Coordinator to support our creative teams and help streamline project execution from start to finish.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented **Content Writer** to join our marketing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for crafting compelling blog articles and engaging website content that aligns with our brand voice, improves SEO rankings, and resonates with our target audience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Research, plan, write, and edit high-quality blog posts on industry-related topics
* Create engaging and SEO-optimized website content (landing pages, product/service pages, company pages, etc.)
* Collaborate with SEO, design, and marketing teams to align content strategy with business goals
* Conduct keyword research and apply on-page SEO best practices
* Proofread and edit content for clarity, grammar, and consistency
* Monitor content performance and update existing articles to improve ranking and engagement

* Ability to handle multiple projects and meet deadlines
* Bachelor’s degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Marketing, or related field (preferred)

* Knowledge of tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, or Ahrefs

Full-Time

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Job Title: Project Co-Ordinator**  
**Company : Antsquad Branding Studio**  
**Job Location: Anna Silai, Coimbatore**

**About the Role** HighThink Media Box is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and ownership-driven Project Coordinator to lead and manage branding and creative projects from initiation to final delivery. This role is critical to our agency’s success, acting as the central bridge between clients, creative teams, and leadership. The Project Coordinator will ensure that every project is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with brand strategy and quality standards.

This is a high-responsibility role and a key pillar in scaling HighThink Media Box operations. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced creative environment, understands branding workflows, and can manage multiple projects while maintaining clarity, structure, and accountability across teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Planning & Execution**

* Own and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of branding and creative projects.
* Define project scope, timelines, deliverables, and milestones.
* Break down projects into actionable tasks and assign them to relevant teams.
* Ensure all projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with client expectations.

**Client Coordination & Communication**

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution.
* Understand client requirements, objectives, and brand expectations clearly.
* Provide regular updates, progress reports, and status communication.
* Handle client feedback professionally and translate it into actionable tasks.
* Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear communication and reliability.

**Team Collaboration & Workflow Management**

* Coordinate with Brand Designers, Video Editors, Content Writers, and Digital Marketers.
* Ensure smooth communication between internal teams and avoid bottlenecks.
* Conduct daily/weekly follow-ups to track progress and maintain accountability.
* Ensure all team members are aligned with project goals and deadlines.

**Timeline & Delivery Management**

* Create and maintain project timelines, trackers, and dashboards.
* Monitor progress and proactively address delays or risks.
* Ensure timely delivery without compromising quality.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously with structured prioritization.

**Quality Control & Brand Alignment**

* Ensure all deliverables meet agency quality standards and brand guidelines.
* Review outputs before client submission to maintain consistency and excellence.
* Work closely with creative teams to ensure brand strategy is reflected in execution.

**Meeting & Documentation**

* Schedule and lead internal and client meetings.
* Document meeting notes, action items, and responsibilities.
* Ensure follow-ups are completed within deadlines.
* Maintain structured project documentation, reports, and archives.

**Risk Management & Problem Solving**

* Identify potential risks, delays, or resource gaps early.
* Take proactive steps to resolve issues and keep projects on track.
* Handle unexpected challenges calmly and provide solutions quickly.

**Process Improvement & Productivity**

* Identify gaps in workflows and suggest improvements.
* Implement tools and systems to improve team efficiency and project tracking.
* Contribute to building standard operating procedures (SOPs) for project management.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–4 years of experience in Project Management, Client Servicing, or Operations/Coordination roles.
* Experience in a branding, advertising, digital marketing, or creative agency is highly preferred.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making mindset.
* High level of ownership and accountability.

**Technical & Tool Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Basic understanding of branding processes, creative workflows, and digital marketing deliverables.

**Preferred Traits**

* Understands branding, creativity, and client expectations.
* Can bring structure to a fast-moving creative environment.
* Is highly proactive and solution-oriented.
* Takes complete ownership of projects from start to finish.
* Has strong follow-up discipline and attention to detail.
* Can confidently interact with both clients and internal teams.
* Is adaptable and thrives under pressure.
* Focuses on driving execution leadership that directly impacts client satisfaction, delivery timelines, team productivity, and agency growth.

**Work Location:** In person

**How to Apply**

Send your resume to: **hr@highthink.in**  
Or contact HR Manager at: **90922 50922**

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

**Company:** Bolt Digitech

**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹23,000/month *(based on skills \& experience)*  
**Experience:** Minimum 1 to 3 years

About Bolt Digitech

Bolt Digitech is a digital marketing company working with **MNCs, brands, founders, doctors, and HNIs** through influencer marketing, social media marketing, and personal branding.

We also have **Coimbatore’s 1st premium 12\+ theme studio** for professional shoots.

Roles \& Responsibilities

* **Personal Branding Scripts** **for Instagram Reels \& YouTube Shorts**.
* Write **strong hooks** to capture attention in the first few seconds.
* Strong **storytelling and creative thinking** skills.
* Understand **Instagram algorithm, audience targeting \& retention**.
* Plan scripts based on **content duration, pacing and engagement**.
* Research **trends and audience interests** to generate relevant content.
* Create scripts with a clear **Hook → Story → Value → CTA** structure.
* Experience in **social\-media/short\-form content writing** preferred.

What You Get

* Good salary with performance\-based growth.
* Strong position and long\-term career opportunities.
* Hands\-on learning in **management**.
* Opportunity to develop **leadership and team\-management skills**.
